rationale.conceptual: The method is standard DFT (GGA/PBE) applied to defect formation energy calculations, a well-documented but multi-part algorithm. No novel theory or custom method is required, but correct implementation of the formation energy formalism and charged defect handling demands domain knowledge.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves multiple sequential stages (unit cell relaxation, supercell generation, elemental reference energies, at least eight defect supercell calculations in several charge states, and final data reduction). This amounts to 6+ steps with dependencies, requiring orchestration of a DFT code, pseudopotentials, and data files; data acquisition from literature adds difficulty.

The method is well-established but non-trivial, requiring careful implementation. The pipeline has 6+ stages including environment setup, data acquisition, and several load-bearing DFT runs, making execution fairly complex.
